hypothesis: Do current operating/weather facts improve prediction beyond exact recipient asset/calendar/availability/age, and is the benefit greater with a pretrained language encoder than a same-content simple MLP?

architecture.main_model: Original four-block PaperForecaster; all common parameters and recipe unchanged
architecture.schema_extra: Existing trainable128x128 semantic-output layer only; RNG fork preserves every shared initializer and subsequent random stream

embedding_usual.purpose: TRAIN usual facts with recipient metadata/calendar/availability/age retained

schema_dynamic.purpose: Same dynamic token facts; no language-model weights

schema_usual.purpose: Matched usual-state MLP control, completes encoder by factuality interaction

corpus.source: Original frozen TSG complete TEXT_CORPUS.json, not the later difference-text corpus
corpus.instruction: Represent this energy forecasting context, preserving asset identity, observation availability, current operating state, and the direction and magnitude of changes.
corpus.tokenizer: Pinned Qwen3-Embedding-8B tokenizer; same token IDs and official terminal token for both models; no chat template
corpus.pooling: last valid token of final layer, FP32 thenL2

usual_estimator.statistic: TRAIN categorical mode, tie low thenmiddle thenhigh; never use target labels
usual_estimator.bins: task/asset/month/weekday, thenmonth, thenweekday, thenasset; require16uniqueTRAINorigins. Wind onlyactual ordinal dailyphase thenasset, no weekday/season invention.
usual_estimator.recipient_metadata: Byte-exact prefix/suffix around the3operation/weather values; keep real missingness, known_future_fields, origin, observation_age and allavailable_groups

schema.encoder: Identical Embedding tokenizer, instruction and EOS;4096 tokenIDmodulo bins, L2normalized; learned4096->128->128 MLP inside unchanged predictor/controller
schema.limits: Token-frequency control omits ordering and has hash collisions. Beating it alone is insufficient to claim general linguistic reasoning. Strong existing numeric_state/concat controls remain secondary references.

training.loss: equal-task TRAIN-mean-absolute-scale masked Huber1 plus1e-4 pre-strength branch energy

selection.metric: complete four-task VAL asset-macro NMAE mean
